def id [a] (x: a): a = x

def iota (n: i64): []i64 =
  loop acc = [] for i in 0..<n do acc ++ [i]

def enumerate [a] (arr: []a): [](i64, a) =
  map (\i -> (i, arr[i])) (iota (length arr))

def copy [n] [a] (x: [n]a): [n]a = x

def sort_by [k] (cmp: k -> k -> bool) (arr: []k): []k =
  loop arr = arr for i in 1..<length arr do
    loop arr = arr for j in 0..<length arr - i do
      if cmp arr[j+1] arr[j] then
        let tmp = arr[j]
        in arr with [j] = arr[j+1], [j+1] = tmp
      else arr

let initial_context: thread_local_state = {
  grad_mode = false,
  worker_device = -1,
  checkpoint_valid = true,
  current_depth = 0,
  total_depth = 0
}

let the_compiled_autograd: opt compiled_autograd_fn = #none
let num_threads_in_compiled_autograd: i32 = 0

let kUndefinedScalar: scalar_type = -1
let kFloat32: scalar_type = 1
let kFloat64: scalar_type = 2
let kComplex64: scalar_type = 3
let kComplex128: scalar_type = 4

def get_device_type(d: device): device_type = d.0
def get_device_index(d: device): device_index = d.1

def node_task_get_reentrant_depth(task: node_task): i32 =
  match task.base
  case #none -> 2147483647
  case #some _ -> 2147483647

def checkpoint_valid_guard_create(ctx: thread_local_state, gt: graph_task): thread_local_state =
  ctx with checkpoint_valid = (gt.keep_graph && ctx.checkpoint_valid)

def checkpoint_valid_guard_restore(ctx: thread_local_state, prev: bool): thread_local_state =
  ctx with checkpoint_valid = prev

def ready_queue_push(q: ready_queue, item: node_task, increment: bool): ready_queue =
  q with heap = item :: q.heap

def ready_queue_push_many(q: ready_queue, items: []node_task): ready_queue =
  loop q = q for t in items do ready_queue_push q t false

def input_buffer_empty(): input_buffer =
  {buffer = [], ready_events = [], ready_streams = []}

def node_stub(): node =
  {
    name = [], sequence_nr = 0, topological_nr = 0u64, next_edges = [],
    num_inputs = 0, stream = #none, input_metadata = [], pre_hooks = [],
    tensor_pre_hooks = [], post_hooks = [], retains_grad_hooks = [], ptr = 0,
    forward = \xs -> xs, device = (-1, -1)
  }

def ready_queue_push_shutdown(q: ready_queue): ready_queue =
  let task: node_task = {
    base = #none,
    fn = node_stub(),
    inputs = input_buffer_empty(),
    isShutdownTask = true
  }
  in q with heap = task :: q.heap

def ready_queue_size(q: ready_queue): i32 =
  i32.i64 (length q.heap)

def ready_queue_pop(q: ready_queue): (ready_queue, node_task) =
  match q.heap
  case [] -> (q, {base = #none, fn = node_stub(), inputs = input_buffer_empty(), isShutdownTask = true})
  case h :: t -> (q with heap = t, h)

def ready_queue_empty(q: ready_queue): bool =
  length q.heap == 0

def ready_queue_create(): ready_queue =
  {heap = [], mutex = 0, not_empty = 0}

def thread_pool_shared_create(): thread_pool_shared =
  {mutex = 0, num_workers = 0, work = 0, graphtasks_queue = []}

def engine_create(): engine =
  {
    non_reentrant_device_thread_count = 0,
    stopped = false,
    device_ready_queues = [],
    thread_pool_shared = thread_pool_shared_create(),
    max_recursion_depth = 2
  }

def graph_task_guard_create(gt: graph_task): opt graph_task =
  #some gt

def graph_task_guard_restore(prev: opt graph_task): unit = ()

def get_current_graph_task_exec_info(gt: opt graph_task): [] (node_ptr, exec_info) =
  match gt
  case #none -> []
  case #some g -> g.exec_info

def get_current_graph_task_nodes_in_graph(gt: opt graph_task): []node_ptr =
  match gt
  case #none -> []
  case #some g -> g.nodes_in_graph

def get_current_graph_task_id(gt: opt graph_task): i32 =
  match gt
  case #none -> -1
  case #some g -> i32.u64 g.id

def get_current_graph_task_keep_graph(gt: opt graph_task): bool =
  match gt
  case #none -> true
  case #some g -> g.keep_graph

def map_find [k] [v] (arr: [] (k, v), key: k): opt v =
  loop acc = #none for p in arr do
    match acc
    case #some _ -> acc
    case #none -> if p.0 == key then #some p.1 else #none

def map_erase [k] [v] (arr: [] (k, v), key: k): [] (k, v) =
  filter (\p -> p.0 != key) arr

def map_set [k] [v] (arr: [] (k, v), key: k, val: v): [] (k, v) =
  (key, val) :: map_erase arr key

def map_update_i32 [k] (arr: [] (k, i32), key: k, f: i32 -> i32): [] (k, i32) =
  map (\p -> if p.0 == key then (p.0, f p.1) else p) arr

def add_node_to_current_graph_task_exec_info(gt: opt graph_task, fn: node): opt graph_task =
  match gt
  case #none -> #none
  case #some g ->
    let info: exec_info = {needed = true, captures = #none}
    let exec_info = map_set g.exec_info fn.ptr info
    in #some (g with exec_info = exec_info)

def contains_elem(arr: []node_ptr, p: node_ptr): bool =
  loop acc = false for x in arr do acc || (x == p)

def call_pre_hooks(fn: node, inputs: []tensor): []tensor =
  loop acc = inputs for h in fn.pre_hooks do
    h acc inputs

def call_tensor_pre_hooks(fn: node, inputs: []tensor): []tensor =
  loop acc = inputs for h in fn.tensor_pre_hooks do
    h acc

def call_post_hooks(fn: node, outputs: []tensor, inputs: []tensor, had_post_hooks: bool): []tensor =
  loop acc = outputs for h in fn.post_hooks do
    if had_post_hooks then h acc inputs else h acc []

def set_device(ctx: thread_local_state, device: i32): thread_local_state =
  ctx with worker_device = device

def get_input_metadata_edge(e: edge): input_metadata =
  e.function.input_metadata[i64 e.input_nr]

def has_input_metadata_edge(e: edge): bool =
  let nr = i64 e.input_nr
  in nr >= 0 && nr < length e.function.input_metadata

def collect_input_metadata(edges: []edge): [] (opt input_metadata) =
  map (\e -> if has_input_metadata_edge e then #some (get_input_metadata_edge e) else #none) edges

def is_defined(t: tensor): bool =
  t.scalar_type != kUndefinedScalar

def is_floating(st: scalar_type): bool =
  st == kFloat32 || st == kFloat64

def is_complex(st: scalar_type): bool =
  st == kComplex64 || st == kComplex128

def validate_outputs_impl(input_metadata_container: [] (opt input_metadata), grads: []tensor, format_error: string -> string): ([]tensor, string) =
  if length grads != length input_metadata_container then
    (grads, format_error ([]))
  else
    loop (gs, err) = (grads, []) for i in iota (length grads) do
      if length err != 0 then (gs, err)
      else
        match input_metadata_container[i]
        case #none -> (gs, err)
        case #some metadata ->
          let grad = gs[i]
          in
          if not (is_defined grad) then (gs, err)
          else
            let grad_reduced = metadata.maybe_reduce (i32.i64 i) grad format_error
            let grad_dtype = grad_reduced.scalar_type
            let input_is_complex = is_complex metadata.options.dtype
            let grad_is_complex = is_complex grad_dtype
            in
            if is_floating grad_dtype || (input_is_complex == grad_is_complex) then
              (gs, err)
            else (gs, format_error ([]))

def validate_outputs(edges: []edge, grads: []tensor, format_error: string -> string): ([]tensor, string) =
  let input_metadata = collect_input_metadata edges
  in validate_outputs_impl input_metadata grads format_error

def input_buffer_to_variables(ib: input_buffer): []tensor =
  ib.buffer

def call_function(gt: graph_task, func: node, inputBuffer: input_buffer): ([]tensor, string) =
  let inputs0 = input_buffer_to_variables inputBuffer
  let inputs1 = call_tensor_pre_hooks func inputs0
  let inputs2 = call_pre_hooks func inputs1
  let has_post_hooks = length func.post_hooks > 0
  let outputs = if has_post_hooks then func.forward (copy inputs2) else func.forward inputs2
  let (valid_outputs, err) = validate_outputs func.next_edges outputs (\msg -> func.name ++ ([] ) ++ msg)
  in if length err == 0 then (call_post_hooks func valid_outputs inputs2 has_post_hooks, []) else ([], err)

let undefined_tensor: tensor = { data = [], scalar_type = kUndefinedScalar }

def input_buffer_create(size: i64): input_buffer =
  {buffer = replicate size undefined_tensor, ready_events = [], ready_streams = replicate size #none}

def input_buffer_add(ib: input_buffer, nr: i32, t: tensor, ps: opt stream, ns: opt stream, fn_ptr: node_ptr): input_buffer =
  let idx = i64 nr
  in ib with buffer = ib.buffer with [idx] = t

def node_task_create(gt: graph_task, fn: node, ib: input_buffer): node_task =
  {base = #some (i64.u64 gt.id), fn = fn, inputs = ib, isShutdownTask = false}

def ready_queue_for_device(cpu_q: ready_queue, dev: device): ready_queue =
  cpu_q

def is_valid_edge(e: edge): bool = true

def update_captured_var(gt: graph_task, idx: i32, t: tensor): graph_task =
  let vars = gt.captured_vars
  let i = i64 idx
  in if i >= 0 && i < length vars then gt with captured_vars = vars with [i] = t else gt

def process_output_edge(gt: graph_task, next_edge: edge, output: tensor, cpu_queue: ready_queue, parent_stream: opt stream): (graph_task, []node_task) =
  if not (is_valid_edge next_edge) then (gt, [])
  else
    let deps_opt = map_find gt.dependencies next_edge.function.ptr
    let (is_ready, new_deps) =
      match deps_opt
      case #none -> (true, gt.dependencies)
      case #some d ->
        if d - 1 == 0 then (true, map_erase gt.dependencies next_edge.function.ptr)
        else (false, map_update_i32 gt.dependencies next_edge.function.ptr (\x -> x - 1))
    let gt = gt with dependencies = new_deps
    let should_exec =
      match map_find gt.exec_info next_edge.function.ptr
      case #none -> true
      case #some info -> info.needed
    in
    if not should_exec then (gt, [])
    else
      match map_find gt.not_ready next_edge.function.ptr
      case #none ->
        let ib0 = input_buffer_create (i64 next_edge.function.num_inputs)
        let ib1 = input_buffer_add ib0 next_edge.input_nr output parent_stream next_edge.function.stream next_edge.function.ptr
        in
        if is_ready then
          (gt, [node_task_create gt next_edge.function ib1])
        else
          (gt with not_ready = map_set gt.not_ready next_edge.function.ptr ib1, [])
      case #some existing ->
        let ib1 = input_buffer_add existing next_edge.input_nr output parent_stream next_edge.function.stream next_edge.function.ptr
        in
        if is_ready then
          let gt = gt with not_ready = map_erase gt.not_ready next_edge.function.ptr
          in (gt, [node_task_create gt next_edge.function ib1])
        else
          (gt with not_ready = map_set gt.not_ready next_edge.function.ptr ib1, [])

def evaluate_function(gt: graph_task, func: node, inputs: input_buffer, cpu_ready_queue: ready_queue): (graph_task, []node_task, string) =
  let parent_stream = func.stream
  let exec_info = gt.exec_info
  let ptr = func.ptr
  let (outputs, err, gt) =
    if length exec_info > 0 then
      match map_find exec_info ptr
      case #none -> ([], [], gt)
      case #some fn_info ->
        if not fn_info.needed then
          let hooked_inputs = call_tensor_pre_hooks func (input_buffer_to_variables inputs)
          let gt =
            match fn_info.captures
            case #none -> gt
            case #some caps ->
              loop gt = gt for c in caps do
                let captured_grad = hooked_inputs[i64 c.input_idx]
                in update_captured_var gt c.output_idx captured_grad
          in ([], [], gt)
        else
          let (outs, e) = call_function gt func inputs
          in (outs, e, gt)
    else
      let (outs, e) = call_function gt func inputs
      in (outs, e, gt)
  in
  if length err != 0 then (gt, [], err)
  else
    let (gt, tasks) =
      loop (gt, tasks) = (gt, []) for (i, out) in enumerate outputs do
        if i < length func.next_edges then
          let edge = func.next_edges[i]
          let (gt, new_tasks) = process_output_edge gt edge out cpu_ready_queue parent_stream
          in (gt, tasks ++ new_tasks)
        else (gt, tasks)
    in (gt, tasks, [])

def compute_min_topological_nr(outputs: []edge): u64 =
  loop m = 18446744073709551615u64 for e in outputs do
    let nr = e.function.topological_nr
    in if nr < m then nr else m

def bfs_traverse(root: node, deps: [] (node_ptr, i32), nodes: []node_ptr, min_topo: u64): ([] (node_ptr, i32), []node_ptr) =
  let queue = [root]
  in
  loop (deps, nodes, q) = (deps, nodes, queue) while length q > 0 do
    match q
    case [] -> (deps, nodes, [])
    case fn :: rest ->
      if fn.topological_nr < min_topo then (deps, nodes, rest)
      else
        let (deps, nodes, rest) =
          loop (deps, nodes, rest) = (deps, nodes, rest) for e in fn.next_edges do
            let nxt = e.function
            let p = nxt.ptr
            in
            if nxt.topological_nr < min_topo then (deps, nodes, rest)
            else
              let already = contains_elem nodes p
              in
              if already then
                let deps =
                  match map_find deps p
                  case #none -> deps
                  case #some _ -> deps
                in (deps, nodes, rest)
              else
                let deps =
                  match map_find deps p
                  case #none -> map_set deps p 1
                  case #some _ -> map_update_i32 deps p (\x -> x + 1)
                let nodes = p :: nodes
                in (deps, nodes, rest ++ [nxt])
        in (deps, nodes, rest)

def compute_dependencies(root: node, task: graph_task, min_topo_nr: u64): graph_task =
  let (deps, nodes) = bfs_traverse root [] [] min_topo_nr
  in task with dependencies = deps, nodes_in_graph = nodes

def graph_task_create(keep_graph: bool, grad_mode: bool, reentrant_depth: i32, cpu_q: ready_queue, roots: []node, exit_on_error: bool): graph_task =
  {
    keep_graph = keep_graph, grad_mode = grad_mode, reentrant_depth = reentrant_depth, exit_on_error = exit_on_error,
    cpu_ready_queue = cpu_q, graph_roots = roots, id = 0u64, future_result = {completed = false, value = [], error = #none},
    thread_locals = {grad_mode = grad_mode, worker_device = -1, checkpoint_valid = true, current_depth = 0, total_depth = 0},
    outstanding_tasks = 0, has_error = false, exec_info = [], not_ready = [], captured_vars = [],
    leaf_streams = [], caller_current_streams = [], future_completed = false, completed = false,
    mutex = 0, final_callbacks_lock = 0, final_callbacks = [], dependencies = [], nodes_in_graph = [], owner = 0
  }

def get_next_fn(f: frame): opt node =
  let idx = i64 f.next_next_fn
  in if idx < 0 || idx >= length f.fn.next_edges then #none else #some f.fn.next_edges[idx].function

def init_to_execute(gt: graph_task, graph_root: node, outputs: []edge, accumulate_grad: bool, min_topo_nr: u64): graph_task =
  let exec_info =
    loop ei = gt.exec_info for (i, out_e) in enumerate outputs do
      let info =
        if accumulate_grad
        then {needed = true, captures = #none}
        else {needed = false, captures = #some [{output_idx = i32.i64 i, input_idx = out_e.input_nr}]}
      in map_set ei out_e.function.ptr info
  let captured_vars =
    if accumulate_grad then []
    else replicate (length outputs) undefined_tensor
  let gt = gt with exec_info = exec_info, captured_vars = captured_vars
  let stack: []frame = [{fn = graph_root, next_next_fn = 0}]
  let seen: []node_ptr = []
  let (exec_info, stack, seen) =
    loop (exec_info, stack, seen) = (exec_info, stack, seen) while length stack > 0 do
      let top = stack[length stack - 1]
      let rest = stack[0:length stack - 1]
      match get_next_fn top
      case #none -> (exec_info, rest, seen)
      case #some child ->
        let top_next = top with next_next_fn = top.next_next_fn + 1
        let stack = rest ++ [top_next]
        in
        if child.topological_nr < min_topo_nr then (exec_info, stack, seen)
        else
          if contains_elem seen child.ptr then
            let needed = match map_find exec_info child.ptr with #none -> false | #some i -> i.needed
            let exec_info = if needed then map_set exec_info top.fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none} else exec_info
            in (exec_info, stack, seen)
          else
            let seen = child.ptr :: seen
            let stack = stack ++ [{fn = child, next_next_fn = 0}]
            in (exec_info, stack, seen)
  in gt with exec_info = exec_info

def is_needed(exec_info: [] (node_ptr, exec_info), ptr: node_ptr): bool =
  match map_find exec_info ptr
  case #none -> false
  case #some info -> info.needed

def propagate_needed(fn: node, exec_info: [] (node_ptr, exec_info), seen: []node_ptr, min_topo: u64): ([] (node_ptr, exec_info), []node_ptr) =
  loop (ei, sn) = (exec_info, seen) for e in fn.next_edges do
    let child = e.function
    let p = child.ptr
    in
    if child.topological_nr < min_topo then (ei, sn)
    else
      if contains_elem sn p then
        if is_needed ei p then (map_set ei fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none}, sn) else (ei, sn)
      else
        let sn = p :: sn
        let (ei, _) = propagate_needed child ei sn min_topo
        in if is_needed ei p then (map_set ei fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none}, sn) else (ei, sn)

def prune_graph(gt: graph_task, root: node, outputs: []edge, min_topo: u64): graph_task =
  let (ei, _) = propagate_needed root gt.exec_info [] min_topo
  in gt with exec_info = ei

def get_current_graph_task_execution_order(gt: opt graph_task): []node =
  match gt
  case #none -> []
  case #some g ->
    let nodes = map (\p -> node_stub()) (map (\x -> x.0) g.dependencies)
    in sort_by (\n1 n2 -> n1.sequence_nr < n2.sequence_nr) nodes

def graph_task_completed(gt: graph_task): bool =
  gt.outstanding_tasks == 0 || (gt.exit_on_error && gt.has_error)

def exec_post_processing(gt: graph_task): graph_task =
  let _synced =
    loop synced = true for leaf in gt.leaf_streams do
      let idx = leaf.0.1
      let caller = if i64 idx < length gt.caller_current_streams then
                     match gt.caller_current_streams[i64 idx]
                     case #none -> false
                     case #some s -> s == leaf
                   else false
      in synced && caller
  let out = gt.captured_vars
  in gt with future_result = gt.future_result with value = out

def finalize_graph_task(gt: graph_task): graph_task =
  if gt.future_completed then gt
  else
    let gt = exec_post_processing gt
    in gt with future_result = gt.future_result with completed = true, future_completed = true, completed = true

def engine_initialize_device_threads_pool(eng: engine): engine =
  if length eng.device_ready_queues > 0 then eng
  else
    let num_devices = 4
    let qs = map (\_ -> ready_queue_create()) (iota (i64 num_devices))
    in eng with device_ready_queues = qs

def engine_add_thread_pool_task(eng: engine, gt: graph_task): engine =
  let shared = eng.thread_pool_shared
  let shared_q = shared.graphtasks_queue ++ [i64.u64 gt.id]
  in eng with thread_pool_shared = shared with graphtasks_queue = shared_q

def thread_main_loop(gt: graph_task): (graph_task, unit) =
  loop gt = gt while not gt.future_result.completed do
    let (q, task) = ready_queue_pop gt.cpu_ready_queue
    let gt = gt with cpu_ready_queue = q
    in

      case #some existing ->

          let gt = gt with not_ready = map_erase gt.not_ready next_edge.function.ptr

  let queue = [root]
  in
  loop (deps, nodes, q) = (deps, nodes, queue) while length q > 0 do
    match q
    case [] -> (deps, nodes, [])
    case fn :: rest ->
      if fn.topological_nr < min_topo then (deps, nodes, rest)
      else
        let (deps, nodes, rest) =
          loop (deps, nodes, rest) = (deps, nodes, rest) for e in fn.next_edges do
            let nxt = e.function
            let p = nxt.ptr
            in
            if nxt.topological_nr < min_topo then (deps, nodes, rest)
            else
              let already = contains_elem nodes p
              in
              if already then
                let deps =
                  match map_find deps p
                  case #none -> deps
                  case #some _ -> deps
                in (deps, nodes, rest)
              else
                let deps =
                  match map_find deps p
                  case #none -> map_set deps p 1
                  case #some _ -> map_update_i32 deps p (\x -> x + 1)
                let nodes = p :: nodes

def get_next_fn(f: frame): opt node =
  let idx = i64 f.next_next_fn
  in if idx < 0 || idx >= length f.fn.next_edges then #none else #some f.fn.next_edges[idx].function

def init_to_execute(gt: graph_task, graph_root: node, outputs: []edge, accumulate_grad: bool, min_topo_nr: u64): graph_task =
  let exec_info =
    loop ei = gt.exec_info for (i, out_e) in enumerate outputs do
      let info =
        if accumulate_grad
        then {needed = true, captures = #none}
        else {needed = false, captures = #some [{output_idx = i32.i64 i, input_idx = out_e.input_nr}]}
      in map_set ei out_e.function.ptr info
  let captured_vars =
    if accumulate_grad then []
    else replicate (length outputs) undefined_tensor
  let gt = gt with exec_info = exec_info, captured_vars = captured_vars
  let stack: []frame = [{fn = graph_root, next_next_fn = 0}]
  let seen: []node_ptr = []
  let (exec_info, stack, seen) =
    loop (exec_info, stack, seen) = (exec_info, stack, seen) while length stack > 0 do
      let top = stack[length stack - 1]
      let rest = stack[0:length stack - 1]
      match get_next_fn top
      case #none -> (exec_info, rest, seen)
      case #some child ->
        let top_next = top with next_next_fn = top.next_next_fn + 1
        let stack = rest ++ [top_next]
        in
        if child.topological_nr < min_topo_nr then (exec_info, stack, seen)
        else
          if contains_elem seen child.ptr then
            let needed = match map_find exec_info child.ptr with #none -> false | #some i -> i.needed
            let exec_info = if needed then map_set exec_info top.fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none} else exec_info
            in (exec_info, stack, seen)
          else
            let seen = child.ptr :: seen
            let stack = stack ++ [{fn = child, next_next_fn = 0}]
            in (exec_info, stack, seen)
  in gt with exec_info = exec_info

def is_needed(exec_info: [] (node_ptr, exec_info), ptr: node_ptr): bool =
  match map_find exec_info ptr
  case #none -> false
  case #some info -> info.needed

def propagate_needed(fn: node, exec_info: [] (node_ptr, exec_info), seen: []node_ptr, min_topo: u64): ([] (node_ptr, exec_info), []node_ptr) =
  loop (ei, sn) = (exec_info, seen) for e in fn.next_edges do
    let child = e.function
    let p = child.ptr
    in
    if child.topological_nr < min_topo then (ei, sn)
    else
      if contains_elem sn p then
        if is_needed ei p then (map_set ei fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none}, sn) else (ei, sn)
      else
        let sn = p :: sn
        let (ei, _) = propagate_needed child ei sn min_topo
        in if is_needed ei p then (map_set ei fn.ptr {needed = true, captures = #none}, sn) else (ei, sn)

def prune_graph(gt: graph_task, root: node, outputs: []edge, min_topo: u64): graph_task =
  let (ei, _) = propagate_needed root gt.exec_info [] min_topo
  in gt with exec_info = ei

def get_current_graph_task_execution_order(gt: opt graph_task): []node =
  match gt
  case #none -> []
  case #some g ->
    let nodes = map (\p -> node_stub()) (map (\x -> x.0) g.dependencies)
    in sort_by (\n1 n2 -> n1.sequence_nr < n2.sequence_nr) nodes

def graph_task_completed(gt: graph_task): bool =
  gt.outstanding_tasks == 0 || (gt.exit_on_error && gt.has_error)

def exec_post_processing(gt: graph_task): graph_task =
  let _synced =
    loop synced = true for leaf in gt.leaf_streams do
      let idx = leaf.0.1
      let caller = if i64 idx < length gt.caller_current_streams then
                     match gt.caller_current_streams[i64 idx]
                     case #none -> false
                     case #some s -> s == leaf
                   else false
      in synced && caller
  let out = gt.captured_vars
  in gt with future_result = gt.future_result with value = out

def finalize_graph_task(gt: graph_task): graph_task =
  if gt.future_completed then gt
  else
    let gt = exec_post_processing gt
    in gt with future_result = gt.future_result with completed = true, future_completed = true, completed = true

def engine_initialize_device_threads_pool(eng: engine): engine =
  if length eng.device_ready_queues > 0 then eng
  else
    let num_devices = 4
    let qs = map (\_ -> ready_queue_create()) (iota (i64 num_devices))
    in eng with device_ready_queues = qs

def engine_add_thread_pool_task(eng: engine, gt: graph_task): engine =
  let shared = eng.thread_pool_shared
  let shared_q = shared.graphtasks_queue ++ [i64.u64 gt.id]
  in eng with thread_pool_shared = shared with graphtasks_queue = shared_q

def thread_main_loop(gt: graph_task): (graph_task, unit) =
  loop gt = gt while not gt.future_result.completed do
    let (q, task) = ready_queue_pop gt.cpu_ready_queue
    let gt = gt with cpu_ready_queue = q
    in
    if task.isShutdownTask then
      finalize_graph_task (gt with outstanding_tasks = 0)
    else
      match task.base
      case #none ->
        let gt = gt with outstanding_tasks = gt.outstanding_tasks - 1
        let gt = gt with completed = graph_task_completed gt
        in if gt.completed then finalize_graph_task gt else gt
      case #some _ ->
        let (gt, tasks, err) = evaluate_function gt task.fn task.inputs gt.cpu_ready_queue
        let gt =
          if length err != 0 then
            gt with has_error = true, future_result = gt.future_result with error = #some 1, completed = false
          else gt
        let gt = gt with cpu_ready_queue = ready_queue_push_many gt.cpu_ready_queue tasks
        let gt = gt with outstanding_tasks = gt.outstanding_tasks - 1 + i32.i64 (length tasks)
        let gt = gt with completed = graph_task_completed gt
        in if gt.completed then finalize_graph_task gt else gt
  in (gt, ())

def engine_execute_with_graph_task(eng: engine, gt0: graph_task, root: node, input_buf: input_buffer): (future, engine) =
  let eng = engine_initialize_device_threads_pool eng
  let cpu_q0 = gt0.cpu_ready_queue
  let device = if gt0.thread_locals.worker_device == -1 then 0 else gt0.thread_locals.total_depth + 1
  let ctx = set_device gt0.thread_locals device
  let gt = gt0 with thread_locals = ctx, owner = ctx.worker_device
  let root_task = {base = #some (i64.u64 gt.id), fn = root, inputs = input_buf, isShutdownTask = false}
  let cpu_q = ready_queue_push cpu_q0 root_task true
  let gt = gt with cpu_ready_queue = cpu_q, outstanding_tasks = 1
  let (gt, _) =
    if ctx.current_depth >= 2 then
      let eng = engine_add_thread_pool_task eng gt
      in (gt, ())
    else
      let new_ctx = ctx with total_depth = ctx.total_depth + 1, current_depth = ctx.current_depth + 1
      let gt = gt with thread_locals = new_ctx
      let (gt, _) = thread_main_loop gt
      let final_ctx = gt.thread_locals with current_depth = new_ctx.current_depth - 1, total_depth = new_ctx.total_depth - 1
      in (gt with thread_locals = final_ctx, ())
  in (gt.future_result, eng)

def engine_execute(eng: engine, root_edges: []edge, inputs: []tensor, keep_graph: bool, create_graph: bool, accumulate_grad: bool, outputs: []edge): ([]tensor, engine) =
  let (valid_inputs, err) = validate_outputs root_edges inputs id
  in
  if length err != 0 then ([], eng)
  else
    let cpu_queue = ready_queue_create()
    let roots = map (\e -> e.function) root_edges
    let graph_task0 = graph_task_create keep_graph create_graph 0 cpu_queue roots false
    let min_topo = compute_min_topological_nr outputs
    let graph_root =
      (node_stub()) with next_edges = root_edges, num_inputs = 0, forward = \xs -> xs
    let graph_task1 = compute_dependencies graph_root graph_task0 min_topo
    let graph_task2 =
      if length outputs > 0 then init_to_execute graph_task1 graph_root outputs accumulate_grad min_topo
      else graph_task1
    let input_buf = {buffer = valid_inputs, ready_events = [], ready_streams = replicate (length valid_inputs) #none}
    let (fut, eng) = engine_execute_with_graph_task eng graph_task2 graph_root input_buf
    in (fut.value, eng)

def engine_get_base_engine(): engine = engine_create()
let default_engine_stub: engine_stub = engine_get_base_engine

def engine_set_compiled_autograd(eng: engine, fn: compiled_autograd_fn): unit = ()

def engine_queue_callback(cb: unit_fun): unit = ()

def engine_is_checkpoint_valid(): bool = true

def init_local_ready_queue(q: opt ready_queue): unit = ()

def engine_ready_queue(cpu_q: ready_queue, dev: device): ready_queue = cpu_q

def engine_ready_queue_by_index(cpu_q: ready_queue, idx: i32): ready_queue = cpu_q

def engine_start_device_threads(eng: engine): engine = eng

def engine_stop(eng: engine): engine = eng with stopped = true

def engine_thread_init(eng: engine, device: i32, q: ready_queue): engine = eng

def engine_reentrant_thread_init(eng: engine): unit = ()

def engine_release_workers(eng: engine): engine = eng

def engine_increment_non_reentrant_thread_count(eng: engine): engine =
  eng with non_reentrant_device_thread_count = eng.non_reentrant_device_thread_count + 1

def engine_decrement_non_reentrant_thread_count(eng: engine): engine =
  eng with non_reentrant_device_thread_count = eng.non_reentrant_device_thread_count - 1

def graph_task_set_exception(gt: graph_task, e: exception_ptr, fn: node): graph_task =
  if not gt.has_error then gt with has_error = true, future_result = gt.future_result with error = #some e, future_completed = true
  else gt

def get_compiled_autograd(): opt compiled_autograd_fn = the_compiled_autograd

Nem: ez a szöveg nem „valós formális verifikációs bizonyítás”, hanem egy erősen leegyszerűsített, helyenként stubokkal/no-opokkal kitöltött **modell/pseudokód** (legfeljebb specifikáció-váz), ami szerkezetében a PyTorch autograd engine bizonyos elemeire rímel.

## Mi alapján látszik, mire emlékeztet
A `GraphTask`, `exec_info`, `captured_vars`, `ReadyQueue`, `NodeTask` és az `evaluate_function`/„process output edge” mintázat nagyon hasonló fogalmi blokkokat követ, mint amik a PyTorch C++ autograd engine implementációjában is szerepelnek (pl. `GraphTask::exec_info_` a szükségtelen élek/pruning kezelésére, illetve a „capture” mechanizmus).[1][2][3]
A „compiled autograd” név és a `compiled_autograd_fn`-szerű illesztési pont is konkrétan létező PyTorch-os koncepció (külön indirection layer-rel).[3][4]

## Miért nem tekinthető „valós” implementációnak
A PyTorch-ban a `ReadyQueue` valós szinkronizációt csinál: mutexet fog, condition variable-ön vár, és egy prioritásos adatszerkezetből vesz ki feladatot.[1][3]
A te kódod ezzel szemben a szinkron primitíveket puszta skalárokra redukálja (`mutex = i32`, `condition_variable = i32`), a `pop` pedig egy sima listafejről vesz le elemet és nem blokkol/waitel, tehát nem modellezi a valódi konkurens viselkedést és ütemezést (ami a PyTorch engine egyik lényegi része).[3][1]
Ugyanez igaz a „compiled autograd” részre is: a PyTorch dokumentációja szerint a compiled autograd a backward műveleteket/hookokat is grafba rögzíti és abból generál futtatott függvényt; nálad viszont `the_compiled_autograd = #none`, és több kapcsolódó API is üres/no-op.[4][3]

## Ez akkor formális verifikáció, vagy csak „mock”?
Formális verifikációhoz tipikusan explicit állítások (tételek), invariánsok, pre/post feltételek, bizonyítási lépések/lemmák, és egy tisztázott memória-/konkurencia-modell kell (különösen atomi műveleteknél és queue-k kezelésénél).  
Itt ehelyett sok „mindig igaz”/„nem csinál semmit” jellegű helyettesítés van (pl. konstans reentrancy-depth, `is_valid_edge = true`, engine thread-kezelés no-op), ami arra utal, hogy ez inkább egyszerűsített szimuláció/spec-váz, nem pedig bizonyítás.

## Mit érdemes tisztázni, ha tényleg verifikálni akarsz
Ha a célod formális verifikáció, mondd meg, pontosan milyen tulajdonságot akarsz bizonyítani (pl. „nem vesznek el gradok”, „terminál minden task”, „a `dependencies` sosem megy negatívba”, „captured_vars csak megfelelő indexre íródik”).  
Aztán ehhez érdemes (1) formalizálni a queue ütemezési/szinkron szemantikáját a valós engine-hez közelebb (ReadyQueue-wait, outstanding_tasks atomikussága), és (2) invariánsokat megfogalmazni az `exec_info`/`dependencies`/`not_ready` állapotokra; a PyTorch kódban az `exec_info`-t kifejezetten trimming/pruning célra használják, ami jó kapaszkodó invariánsokhoz.[1]

Milyen konkrét állítást szeretnél „bebizonyítani” erről a modellről: helyesség (correctness), termináció, vagy valamiféle determinisztikusság/konkurens safety?
